# Module registry (M01–M24)

The canonical 24-module map (product plan P0). Each module owns its API prefix; consequential writes from any module go through M23.

| ID | Module | Purpose | API prefix | Depends on | Aliases |

| M03 | Brand & Product Knowledge Graph | Factual ground truth, claim registry, brand rules, retrieval. | `/v1/knowledge` | M01, M24 | brand graph |
